params.name: destinationObject
params.description: Name of the set or named selection, or an empty string when destinationType is 'current selection' or 'variable'.

params.name: destinationPtr
params.description: Pointer to the local variable that receives query results, meaningful only when destinationType is 3 (variable).

constraints: The meaning of destinationObject depends on destinationType: empty string if 0 (current selection) or 3 (variable, use destinationPtr instead); the set name if 1; the named selection name if 2.
destinationPtr only points to a meaningful local variable when destinationType returns 3; otherwise it is not significant.
